form.label: SSL and x509
form.description: x509 analysis is only available for data extracted by Corelight Sensors (open source Zeek sensors not supported)

search.query: `corelight_idx` sensor_name="$sensor_name$" $addl_query$ | `calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)` | search (`corelight_evt_x509` sensor_name="*" ssl_subject=* ) OR ( `corelight_evt_ssl` ) OR (`corelight_evt_conn` $direction$ )|eventstats values(direction) as direction by uid | rename cert_chain_fuids{} AS ccf | search $direction$ NOT `corelight_evt_conn`|eval aid = coalesce(id, ccf) | stats count by ssl_subject

`corelight_idx` `corelight_evt_ssl` sensor_name="$sensor_name$" $addl_query$ ssl_subject=* OR ssl_subject_common_name=* | `calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)`| search $direction$ | eval c_id = coalesce(ssl_subject, ssl_subject_common_name) | top c_id

drilldown.link: search?q=`corelight_idx` `corelight_evt_ssl` NOT sensor_name!="$sensor_name$" $addl_query$ | `calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)`| fields ssl_subject, ssl_subject_common_name, ssl_cipher, direction | search ssl_subject=* OR ssl_subject_common_name=* $direction$ | eval c_id = coalesce(ssl_subject, ssl_subject_common_name) | where c_id=$click.value|s$&earliest=$time_restriction.earliest$&latest=$time_restriction.latest$

search.query: `corelight_idx` (`corelight_evt_ssl` validation_status=*) OR (`corelight_evt_conn` NOT is_broadcast="true" sensor_name="$sensor_name$" $addl_query$ )| `calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)` |search (direction="inbound" OR direction="internal") | eventstats latest(direction) as direction by uid | search `corelight_evt_ssl` direction="internal" OR direction="inbound"| top validation_status

drilldown.link: search?q=`corelight_idx` | `calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)` | search (`corelight_evt_ssl` validation_status=*) OR (`corelight_evt_conn` NOT is_broadcast="true" sensor_name="$sensor_name$" $addl_query$ direction="inbound" OR direction="internal") | eventstats latest(direction) as direction by uid | search `corelight_evt_ssl` direction="internal" OR direction="inbound" validation_status="$click.value$"&earliest=$time_restriction.earliest$&latest=$time_restriction.latest$

search.query: `corelight_idx` `corelight_evt_ssl` sensor_name="$sensor_name$" $addl_query$ ssl_cipher=* | `calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)`| search $direction$ | top ssl_cipher

drilldown.link: search?q=`corelight_idx` `corelight_evt_ssl` NOT sensor_name!="$sensor_name$" | `calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)` | search $addl_query$ | fields ssl_subject, ssl_subject_common_name, ssl_cipher, direction | search ssl_cipher=$click.value$ $direction$&earliest=$time_restriction.earliest$&latest=$time_restriction.latest$

search.query: `corelight_idx` sensor_name=$sensor_name|s$ $addl_query$ ssl_subject=* eventtype IN (corelight_x509, corelight_ssl, corelight_conn) |`calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)` | search $direction$ | top ssl_subject

drilldown.link: search?q=`corelight_idx` sensor_name=$sensor_name|s$ $addl_query$ eventtype IN (corelight_x509, corelight_ssl, corelight_conn) ssl_subject=$click.value|s$| `calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)` | search $direction$&earliest=$time_restriction.earliest$&latest=$time_restriction.latest$

search.query: `corelight_idx` sensor_name=$sensor_name|s$ $addl_query$ ssl_subject=* eventtype IN (corelight_x509, corelight_ssl, corelight_conn) |`calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)` | search $direction$ | rare ssl_subject

drilldown.link: search?q=`corelight_idx` sensor_name=$sensor_name|s$ $addl_query$ eventtype IN (corelight_x509, corelight_ssl, corelight_conn) ssl_subject=$click.value|s$| `calculate_direction(id_orig_h, id_resp_h)` | search $direction$&earliest=$time_restriction.earliest$&latest=$time_restriction.latest$

search.query: `corelight_idx` `corelight_evt_x509` sensor_name="$sensor_name$" $addl_query$ | rename certificate.* as cert_* | eval ts_now = now(), ts_then = round(strptime(cert_not_valid_after, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%6NZ"),0), now_now = ts_now - ts_then, now_now = coalesce(now_now, ts_now-cert_not_valid_after) | where now_now > 0 | table cert_not_valid_after cert_subject id | rename cert_* as certificate.*
